# Adnan Ai

> Adnan Ai is the personal portfolio and independent service practice of Adnan Ahmad. It builds clear websites, practical automation, and task-focused AI agents for business work in Peshawar and remotely.

## Business information

- Name: Adnan Ai
- Founder: Adnan Ahmad
- Website: https://adnanai.com/
- Email: info@adnanai.com
- Location: KPK, Peshawar, Pakistan

## Services

### Website Development

Responsive websites that explain an offer and make the next step clear for visitors.

### AI Automation

Connected steps for intake, data, notifications, and follow-up around an existing business task.

### AI Agents

Task-focused support for research, intake, recurring questions, and internal work using approved context and human handoff where needed.

## Public projects

- Aqualume water website: https://1st-water-website.vercel.app/
- N A Metal website: https://n-a-metal-lr1v.vercel.app/

## AI system examples

The AI system cards on the website describe practical service patterns, not client testimonials, performance results, or claims about completed client work.
